name: dev.pages.linkvet/linkvet
title: LinkVet
description: Verify before you cite: URL checks, quotes, page-to-Markdown, metadata, schema, links, archives.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL and verify it is live before you cite or share it. Returns status (live | 404 | blocked | timeout | error | invalid | blocked_ssrf), HTTP code, final URL after redirects, page title, detected price, published/modified dates, and safe_to_cite with a reason. Results are cached ~12h.

tools.name: check_urls
tools.description: Batch version of check_url: verify up to 25 URLs in one call (e.g. every link in an answer you are about to send). Returns one result per URL in input order.

tools.name: verify_quote
tools.description: Before you attribute a quote to a source, check that the exact words really appear on that page. Returns found (true only for verbatim or punctuation/case-only differences), match_type (exact | normalized | near | partial | none), similarity 0-1, the closest_match text actually on the page with surrounding context, and safe_to_quote. Use closest_match to correct misquotes.

url.description: Page that supposedly contains the quote

quote.description: The quoted text to look for (3-3000 chars)

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch a public URL and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, scripts, footers removed; links absolutized), plus title, final URL and an estimated token count, truncated to max_tokens. Cheaper on context than raw HTML.

max_tokens.description: Truncate output to about this many tokens (default 8000, max 50000)

tools.name: check_robots
tools.description: Is a given user agent allowed to fetch this URL under the site's robots.txt (RFC 9309 longest-match rules)? Returns allowed, matched_rule, crawl_delay, declared sitemaps, a per-bot verdict for 20 AI/search crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...), and whether the site publishes /llms.txt.

tools.name: find_feeds
tools.description: Discover the RSS, Atom and JSON feeds and the XML sitemaps for a page or site: reads <link rel=alternate>, robots.txt Sitemap lines, and probes common paths (/feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml, /sitemap.xml...). Probed results are verified by content sniffing.

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Validate an email address without sending anything: RFC syntax, whether the domain exists, MX records (or implicit A record / null MX), SPF and DMARC presence, and flags for disposable, free-provider and role addresses (info@, support@). Proves the domain accepts mail, not that the mailbox exists.

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Fetch a public page and return its SEO/social metadata: title, meta description, canonical URL, language, robots directive, all Open Graph (og:*), Twitter card and article:* tags, author, published/modified dates, hreflang alternates and feed links. Use it to build link previews or citations.

tools.name: schema_extract
tools.description: Extract schema.org structured data from a page: every JSON-LD block (flattening @graph), the list of @types (Product, Article, Recipe, Event, Organization, FAQPage...), up to 30 typed items with their fields (prices, ratings, dates, authors), plus microdata itemtypes. Great for pulling clean product/article facts.

tools.name: broken_links
tools.description: Fetch a page, collect its unique outbound/internal links and check each one (in parallel) for 404s, timeouts and connection errors. Returns broken links with their anchor text and the status of every link checked (up to 25 per call).

limit.description: Max unique links to check (default 20, max 25)

tools.name: wayback_snapshot
tools.description: Find the Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot of a URL closest to a date (or the latest). Returns snapshot_url and time. Use it to cite a dead page (when check_url says 404) or to show what a page said at a past date.

timestamp.description: Optional target date, YYYYMMDD or YYYYMMDDhhmmss: returns the closest snapshot
